questions.text:
Nobody knows how the Indian cricket team is going to cope with the difficult and seamer-friendly wickets in Australia.

Choose the option which is closest in meaning to the underlined phrase in the above sentence.
questions.solution:
To cope with something means to manage or tolerate it, i.e. to put up with it.

Answer: Put up with

questions.text:
Find the odd one in the following group of words.

mock, deride, praise, jeer
questions.solution:
Mock, deride and jeer all mean to make fun of someone. Praise is the opposite.

Answer: Praise

questions.text:
In a quadratic function, the value of the product of the roots [latex](\\alpha ,\\beta )[/latex] is 4. Find the value of

[latex]\\frac{\\alpha^{n}+\\beta^{n}}{\\alpha^{-n}+\\beta^{-n}}[/latex]
questions.solution:
[latex]\alpha^{-n}+\beta^{-n}=\frac{\alpha^n+\beta^n}{(\alpha\beta)^n}[/latex], so the ratio is [latex](\alpha\beta)^n=4^n[/latex].

Answer: [latex]4^n[/latex]
